args.subject: Group stay enquiry: 10 people in June at City Hub Tokyo
args.body:
Hello,

I'm organising a group stay for 10 people at City Hub Tokyo in June. Could you please let me know whether you have availability for a group of this size, and what dates and room arrangements might be available?

Please also share your group rates and any group-booking requirements.

Thank you,
Emma Johnson
